newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australian charged with British tourist's murder.
newsitem.headline: Australian charged with British tourist's murder.

text.p: A 22-year-old Australian man was charged on Monday with the murder of British tourist Brian Hagland at Sydney's Bondi Beach on September 7, police said.

The unidentified man from the nearby suburb of Rushcutters Bay voluntarily walked into Bondi Beach police station last week with his lawyer to assist police inquiries. He returned for a second police interview on Monday and was charged with murder.

"A 22-year-old man from Rushcutters Bay has been charged with one count of murder," a police spokeswoman told Reuters. "The man will appear at Waverley local court on Tuesday to be formally charged," she said.
Until the man appears in court he cannot be identified.
Police said investigations into Hagland's murder were continuing since his girlfriend, who witnessed the killing, said two men attacked her fiance.
Hagland, 28, was beaten and kicked to death by two men as he and his girlfriend, Connie Casey, 25, walked home along a well-lit street near Bondi Beach early on Saturday, September 7.
Hagland died from head and internal injuries in hospital shortly after the attack.
Casey and Hagland had been in Australia for eight months and had been due to leave for New Zealand in a few weeks, before returning to Britain to be married.
